Add Null Above

Create a null above the given item in the same space.

Args
::Item:: Item to add a null above.
::New Suffix:: Suffix to append to the end of the new null's name. (ie: myControl_suffix)
::Replace Suffix:: Search for this text in the name and replace with the above New Suffix.


Return
::Null:: The newly created null.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_4
nodes.title:
Control Stack at Position

Create a Control hierarchy Stack at the given transform location.
A "Stack" represents a Control hierarchy that might include a Parent Item and sub-items.

Args
::Global Position:: Location to build the Control.
::Parent:: Item in the hierarchy to place the new Control Stack underneath. (use None for World)
::Name:: Name of the new Control Stack.
::Settings:: The control settings.
::Add Null:: If true, add a null above the control.
::Add Bottom Null:: If true, add a null below the control.
::Add Secondary Null:: If true, add a secondary control below the control.
::Secondary Settings:: The secondary control settings. (Only valid if AddSecondaryControl=True)
::Control Suffix:: The suffix to use for naming the controls.
::Null Suffix:: The suffix to use for naming the nulls.

Return
::Control:: The newly created control.
::Null:: The newly created null. (only valid if AddNull=True)
::Secondary:: The newly created secondary control. (only valid if AddSecondaryControl=True)
::Bottom Null:: The newly created child null. (only valid if AddBottomNull=True)

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_1
nodes.title: If user provides a Name other than None, use that instead.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_4
nodes.title:
Compute Pole Vector

Compute the pole vector plane given 2 bones (3 joints) to help position the pole vector of a 2 bone IK. 

Best used in Setup Event. 

Args
::Bone A:: First bone. Represents start of the first vector.
::Bone B:: Second bone. Represents end of the first vector.
::Bone C:: Third bone. Represents end of the second vector.
::Draw Transform:: Draw the output in the viewport.
::initial:: Compute using initial values.
::Origin Scale:: Additional world scale multipler (eg: character scale control).
::OffsetFactor:: Amount of offset to apply to the output pole vector position.

Return
::Transform:: Postion and Rotation Transform that the pole vector should be placed.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_5
nodes.title:
IK Three Bone.
Typically used in hind dog legs, this Function uses a CCDIK node to drive the structure of the three bones, and then the IKTwoBone function to drive the lower 2 bones that includes a pole vector.

Args
::Primary Axis:: Axis down the bone (typically X)
::Secondary Axis:: Up axis (typically Z or None)
::Pole Vector Node:: Control for the pole vector
::Bone A:: First Bone 
::Bone B:: Second Bone 
::Bone C:: Third Bone 
::Bone D:: Fourth Bone 
::Enable Stretch:: If True the bones will stretch when Ankle Ctrl is translated
::Stretch Maximum Ratio:: Amount to stretch
::Ankle Ctrl:: End of IK control (typically a foot/ankle)
::Thigh Ctrl:: Start of IK control (typically a thigh/shoulder) [Optional]. *Must have a parent null above the control*
::Scale(optional)::  Scale for the entire rig (typically the root)

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_4
nodes.title:
Colorize Controls
Color controls based on position (left, right, center).

Default colors are:
Center = Yellow
Left = Green
Right = Red

Args
::controls:: The controls to color. Best to create a collection searching for *_ctrl or *Control
::CenterColor:: Controls that live in the center of character color.
::LeftColor:: Controls that live on the left side color.
::RightColor:: Controls that live on the right side color.
::X Plane:: Use the x plane to determine Left/Right. (Default)
::Y Plane:: Use the y plane to determine Left/Right.
::Z Plane:: Use the z plane to determine Left/Right.
::Negative:: Use the opposite side to determine Left/Right.
::ignore_ctrls:: Specific controls to not include.
